metric_definitions.shots_fired: Compatibility key for a lower-bound fixed-pistol shot estimate from observed ammunition decreases, not exact engine shot events or ATTACK-command count.
metric_definitions.shots_during_activation: The same lower-bound ammunition-decrease estimate restricted to the covering player during active-console USE.
metric_definitions.completion_seconds: Successful episode decisions * action-repeat / 35 engine tics per second; excludes reset warm-up.

metric_definitions.completion_seconds: Successful episode decisions * action-repeat / 35 engine tics per second; excludes reset warm-up.

renderer.native_barrier: one simulator tic; four tics per logical decision

license_provenance.original_vizdoom_code: MIT; bundled engine components retain their separate licenses
license_provenance.generated_pwads: Original project geometry and scripts; no copied IWAD sprites/textures in generated PWADs.
license_provenance.redistribution: Preserve upstream Freedoom credits/license when distributing the IWAD; do not label the entire engine bundle MIT.

interpretation: Scripted controllers use privileged positions for mechanics validation; these are not learned-policy results or a P1.7 acceptance campaign.

post_run_review.note: Raw marker fixtures recorded visual review as pending at collection time. Both root and independent visual inspections have now completed; original raw fixture reports and images remain unchanged.
known_limits: Same-seed mechanics trajectories were not bitwise identical in an observed repeat; cause unassigned. See exact first-divergence evidence in cover_trace_audit.json.
Ammunition-derived shot estimates are lower bounds because pickups can mask expenditure within four tics.
Three paired development layouts show protection in this sample and equal success; they are not a statistical research conclusion or a learned B-versus-D result.
Extraction bounds were aligned to 64-unit floor sectors; old and new geometry are documented explicitly.
P1.5-P1.7 and training-host validation remain deferred.
